<td style="vertical-align: top; width: 12pt;" valign="top">[2]</td>
<td style="vertical-align: top;" valign="top"><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">These securities were acquired in transactions exempt from registration under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the "Securities Act") and may be deemed to be "restricted securities" under the Securities Act. As o</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">f March 31, 2026, the Company's portfolio company investments that were subject to restrictions on sales totaled </span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">$</span><span style="font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">1,816,338</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> at fair value and represented </span><span style="font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">5.5</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">%</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> of t</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">he Company's net assets.</span></td>

<tr class="outerFootnote">

As defined in the 1940 Act, the Company is deemed to be both an &#8220;affiliated person&#8221; and &#8220;control&#8221; a portfolio company if it owns more than </span><span style="font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">25</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">% of the portfolio company&#8217;s outstanding voting securities or has the power to exercise control over the management or policies of such portfolio company (including through a management agreement). As o</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">f December 31, 2025, t</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">he Company had </span><span style="font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">no</span><span style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:8pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> "Affiliated Investments" or "Control Investments.&#8221;</span></td>
